description: This file declares the BrowserConsoleLog class, which manages logging messages to the browser console with formatted text, including support for different platforms via conditional compilation.

classes.name: BrowserConsoleLog
classes.description: A class for creating and managing browser console log messages, supporting multiple platform-specific constructors and internal text management.

methods.name: BrowserConsoleLog(const string&, const string&, const uint64_t, const uint64_t)
methods.description: Constructor for WebKit_GLIB_API platform, formats a message with prefix, line, column, and message string.

methods.name: BrowserConsoleLog(const string&, const WKStringRef, const uint64_t, const uint64_t)
methods.description: Constructor for non-WebKit_GLIB_API platform, formats a message with prefix, line, column, and WKStringRef message.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the internal message string as a C-style string.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the internal message string.
